dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Sorry! I was just leaving...

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Oh, you're not a sister. Can I help?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Did you just say "Barbara-sama"?

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Yes. Is there something you find strange about that?

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Barbara-sama lights up my world. She is so adorable, so kind, so pure and innocent...

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: ...What's that look for? You think I'm making this up?

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: #You, {M#sir}{F#ma'am}, need to be baptized in the spirit!

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: ...By which I mean, you need to witness one of Barbara-sama's live performances!

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Do you hear me? You must go and watch her performance! *sigh* You ignorant fool... You wouldn't recognize the grace of the gods if it slapped you in the face!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing?

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Nothing, just out for a stroll.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Because this is the closest I can get to Barbara-sama without disrupting her work at the Cathedral!

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Can you smell the scent of honey in the air?

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: ...Um, do you want to join the Barbara Fan Club?

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: 'Cause if you do, you're in luck — I actually run it! Whether you want to show your support through fan activities or get up-to-date info on performance arrangements, once you're a member you can always find someone to point you in the right direction.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: What do you reckon? Give it some thought!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: "Go Barbara, Go!"

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Oh, you're still here? I wasn't being a weirdo, I was just practicing the chant we do at performances.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Stormterror must have been moved by Barbara-sama's charisma, which returned it to its senses at last!

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Barbara-sama's smile is like the dawn that breaks through the darkness. It is the star flashing through the night sky. Even Stormterror cannot withstand her loveliness!

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: If you cannot understand that, then you're part of the problem. You are not yet sufficiently enlightened!

dialogues.speaker: Albert
dialogues.text: Yes, this must be the truth! Go Barbara, Go!
